### The Most Beautiful Love Song You'll Ever Hear
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/the-most-beautiful-love-song-you-ll-ever-hear-encouragement-for-today-february-3-2016.html
Passage: Zephaniah 3:17
Points:
- A mother singing tenderly over her sleeping baby reflects how God delights in His children.
- God’s joy over believers does not depend on performance, perfection, or what they can offer.
- His close presence calms anxieties and replaces feelings of rejection with gentle acceptance.
- Believers can rest peacefully knowing their heavenly Father rejoices over them with song.

### How Zephaniah Helps Us Feel the Glad Love of God
Author: Jonathan Parnell
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-zephaniah-helps-us-feel-the-glad-love-of-god
Passage: Zephaniah 3:17
Points:
- Feelings of unworthiness are resolved because God has removed the judgment against His people.
- Fear of opposition fades when trusting God as the victorious warrior defending His own.
- Senses of insignificance are comforted by the reality of God living in our very midst.
- Deep personal shame is overcome through God's promise to heal the hurting and redeem outcasts.
